messages:
Tara (Recruiter): Quick ask new manager starts next Wed. Hiring manager wants a tiny "pocket guide" for the offer packet: one-paragraph welcome, a compact Day 1 checklist, 5-item first-week plan, and 3-line 30/60/90. Can People Ops + DevEx make a paste-ready snippet?

Priya: Yep. I'll keep it very short so recruiters can paste into the offer email. Will include owners & a one-line 1:1 agenda.

Jordan (IT): FYI laptop lead time ~3 business days. If start date is tight we can enable a managed VM. Need legal name + personal email to pre-create SSO.

Sam (DevEx): I'll add two quick CLI commands to request repo invite + CI token and note deploy perms ramp. Happy to be infra buddy week 1.

Priya: Draft below (single block, copy-paste):

"Welcome (paste): Welcome to Redwood! On Day 1 you'll have a 30-minute welcome with your manager, brief team intros, and immediate steps to get access to code, CI, and monitoring. We'll deliver a 10-day leader sprint and a draft 30/60/90 within the first 10 days to align on priorities.

Day 1 (copy checklist):
- 30m welcome w/ manager: role + top 3 priorities (Manager)
- Team intro round (Manager)
- Laptop SSO + MFA + VPN (IT)
- Access: GitHub org, JIRA, CI tokens, Datadog, Redwood Console (DevEx/IT)
- Schedule weekly 1:1s & send first 1:1 agenda (Manager)

First-week (5 quick items):
- Product & architecture walkthroughs (Tech leads)
- 1:1s with direct reports + skip-level intro (Manager)
- Incident runbook & paging demo (Eng-SRE)
- Complete security quick courses (Security)
- Identify one quick unblock to ship (Manager/New Hire)

30/60/90 (3-line):
- 30d: Understand team, run 1:1s, close onboarding gaps.
- 60d: Own a delivery milestone & suggest one ops improvement.
- 90d: Lead next-quarter planning and present resourcing asks.

One-line 1:1 agenda (first meet): Personal check-in; role priorities; blockers & support; next steps.

Quick ops contacts: IT (Jordan) hardware/SSO; DevEx (Sam) repo/CI; People Ops (Nina) benefits/onboarding; Finance (Diego) headcount sync.

Sam (DevEx): CLI snippets: `devex request-invite --email <email> --team eng-managers` and `devex request-token --service ci`. Note: deploy perms ramp over 30 days.

Diego (Finance): Add a 30-min headcount & budget sync in week 2; I can provide the template.

Priya: I'll publish this to Confluence and drop the link here by EOD. Tara: feel free to paste this into the offer in the meantime.

Tara (Recruiter): Perfect, thanks everyone!
"
